parameters.query:
=SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.country,
    o.currency,
    o.amount,
    o.shipping_fee,
    o.payment_method,
    o.status AS order_status,
    o.refunded,
 
    s.status AS ship_status,
    s.estimated_delivery,
    s.delivered_date,
    s.claim_status,
 
    DATEDIFF(
        CAST(c.asof AS DATE),
        CAST(s.delivered_date AS DATE)
    ) AS days_since_delivery,
 
    CASE
        WHEN s.status = 'delivered' THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(
            0,
            DATEDIFF(
                CAST(c.asof AS DATE),
                CAST(s.estimated_delivery AS DATE)
            )
        )
    END AS days_late,
 
    p.return_window_days,
    p.delay_threshold_days,
    p.auto_limit,
    p.approval_limit,
    p.max_auto_actions_30d,
    p.refund_method,
    p.version AS policy_version,
 
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM workspace.agentic_support.returns r
        WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id
    ) AS return_count,
 
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM workspace.agentic_support.refunds f
        WHERE f.order_id = o.order_id
    ) AS refund_count,
 
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM workspace.agentic_support.audit_log a
        WHERE a.customer_id = o.customer_id
          AND a.route = 'auto'
          AND a.decision = 'Executed'
          AND a.event_time >= DATE_SUB(CAST(c.asof AS DATE), 30)
    ) AS auto_actions_30d,
 
    (
        SELECT CAST(config_value AS INT)
        FROM workspace.agentic_support.config
        WHERE config_key = 'risk_score_escalate'
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS risk_score_escalate,
 
    (
        SELECT CAST(config_value AS INT)
        FROM workspace.agentic_support.config
        WHERE config_key = 'serial_refund_threshold'
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS serial_refund_threshold,
 
    (
        SELECT CAST(config_value AS INT)
        FROM workspace.agentic_support.config
        WHERE config_key = 'damage_report_days'
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS damage_report_days
 
FROM workspace.agentic_support.orders o
 
LEFT JOIN workspace.agentic_support.shipments s
    ON s.order_id = o.order_id
 
JOIN workspace.agentic_support.policies p
    ON p.country = o.country
 
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT CAST(config_value AS DATE) AS asof
    FROM workspace.agentic_support.config
    WHERE config_key = 'as_of_date'
    LIMIT 1
) c
 
WHERE o.order_id = '{{ $json.order_id }}'
  AND o.customer_id = '{{ $json.customer_id }}'

SELECT CONCAT('R', LPAD(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(return_id, '^R([0-9]+)$', 1) AS INT)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) AS next_id
FROM workspace.agentic_support.returns
WHERE return_id RLIKE '^R[0-9]+$'

=INSERT INTO workspace.agentic_support.returns
(
    return_id,
    order_id,
    reason_code,
    reason_text,
    resolution,
    status,
    label_url,
    refund_amount,
    currency,
    created_at
)
SELECT
    '{{ $json.next_id }}',
    o.order_id,
    NULLIF('{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.reason_code }}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.reason_text }}', ''),
    'refund',
    'awaiting_inspection',
    CONCAT('https://watchmate.example/return/', '{{ $json.next_id }}'),
    CAST({{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.refund_amount || 0 }} AS DECIMAL(10, 2)),
    o.currency,
    CURRENT_DATE()
FROM workspace.agentic_support.orders o
WHERE o.order_id = '{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.order_id }}';

=UPDATE workspace.agentic_support.orders
SET status = 'return_requested'
WHERE order_id = "{{ $('Edit Fields3').item.json.order_id }}" AND customer_id = "{{ $('Edit Fields3').item.json.customer_id }}"

=INSERT INTO workspace.agentic_support.order_events
(
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    event,
    detail
)
VALUES
(
    '{{ $('Edit Fields3').item.json.order_id }}',
    '{{ $('Edit Fields3').item.json.customer_id }}',
    'Return requested',
    '{{ $('Edit Fields3').item.json.reason_text }}'
)
